login.body: Sign in with your passkey on this device.
login.lost: Lost your passkey? Use a backup code

register.body: Set up your account. A passkey on this device approves every payment.
register.passkeyNote: Your passkey stays on this device. Kassa only stores the public part.

welcome.demoClaimed: The demo account already has a passkey. Sign in with it instead.
welcome.demoNotSeeded: The demo data is not loaded on the server yet. Try again after it is seeded.
welcome.demoNote: Explore with simulated data. No real money moves.
welcome.demoPersonaUnknown: This demo persona is not loaded on the server. Pick another one or reseed with personas.
welcome.devModeNote: A brand-new account every time, onboarding from the start. Approvals are signed by the Dev key.
welcome.judgeModeNote: Judge build: no passkeys, approvals are signed by the server, and the data resets when the server restarts. The public demo uses real passkeys.
welcome.point1: Kassa drafts payments. Your rules decide what happens.
welcome.point2: Nothing moves without your passkey, now or in a mandate you signed.
welcome.point3: Each approval signs one exact order.
welcome.subtitle: It learns from your bank history, plans your bills across currencies and drafts every payment.
welcome.title: An agent for your money abroad

recover.title: Sign in with a backup code
recover.body: Enter one of the backup codes you saved. This device then gets a new passkey, and the old ones stop working.
recover.frozen: For your safety, payments are frozen. Unfreeze them in Settings with your new passkey (takes 24 hours). Backup codes left: {{count}}.
